candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect Gray-to-binary conversion changes the sequence of Gray codes produced. The AND operation instead of XOR will cause incorrect binary values to be generated, leading to wrong Gray code outputs after conversion.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires correct Gray-to-binary conversion where each bit is XORed with the next more significant bit
